title: DFT Engineer
summary: Adds test logic to chips so every manufactured die can be checked for defects: scan chains, built-in self-test for memories and boundary scan. Sits in the SoC design team between RTL designers, physical design and the test engineers who run patterns on testers.
dailyDuties: Insert scan chains and test compression into RTL or netlists
Generate ATPG patterns and push test coverage up
Insert and verify memory BIST and repair logic
Simulate test patterns at gate level and debug failures
Write test-mode timing constraints with the STA team
Script DFT flows in Tcl or Python
Help the test team debug pattern failures on silicon

skills.expectation: Insert scan chains and compression, and generate ATPG patterns that hit coverage targets
Insert and verify MBIST for on-chip memories, including repair
Add boundary scan and IJTAG networks to IEEE 1149.1 and 1687
Simulate scan and MBIST patterns at gate level and debug failures
Read and edit Verilog RTL to add test logic and fix testability issues
Write test-mode constraints and close timing in scan shift and capture
Understand flops, clocks and resets well enough to reason about fault models
Run DFT rule checks such as Spyglass DFT on RTL
Support tester bring-up and silicon failure diagnosis
Handle DFT across power domains described in UPF
Work with the PD team on scan chain reordering and test logic placement
